en.headline: Observatory warns of heavier showers and squally thunderstorms
en.dek: A special weather tip at 7.45am said a rain band south of Hong Kong was approaching, while the Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special weather tip at 7.45am on Sunday, saying a rain band over waters south of Hong Kong was moving closer and that heavier rain and squally thunderstorms were expected in some areas over the following two to three hours. The Observatory advised people heading outdoors to watch for sudden changes in the weather.

The Strong Monsoon Signal remained in force. The Observatory said strong easterly winds with a mean speed exceeding 40 kilometres an hour were expected, with gusts occasionally reaching gale force. People not well sheltered from the east were told to secure flower pots and other loose objects, and those planning water sports or work at sea were advised to take extra care as offshore waters were particularly rough.

Sunday’s forecast, updated at 7.50am, was mainly cloudy with a few showers, heavier in places with thunderstorms at first, then brighter periods in the afternoon and a maximum of about 30 degrees. Winds were forecast to be fresh easterly, strong offshore at first and occasionally up to gale force on high ground, with rough seas and swells.

A tropical depression over the central South China Sea was, at 8am, near 17.1 degrees north, 107.9 degrees east, and was expected to move towards the Vietnam coast. The Observatory said the northeast monsoon and the system together would keep the Guangdong coast and northern South China Sea windy with occasional showers. Monday was expected to bring sunny intervals with showers and isolated thunderstorms in the morning and at night.

zh.headline: 天文台：雷雨帶靠近 未來兩三小時局部雨勢較大
zh.dek: 天文台周日早上7晈45分發特別天氣提示，本港以南雷雨帶逐漸靠近，強烈季候風信號仍然生效。
body: 香港天文台周日早上7晈45分發出特別天氣提示，指位於本港以南海域的雷雨帶正逐漸靠近，預料未來兩三小時部分地區雨勢較大及有狂風雷暴，呼籲市民外出或進行戶外活動時留意天氣變化。
強烈季候風信號仍然生效。天文台表示，預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。處身東面風口的市民應將花盆及其他容易被風吹走的物件移入室內；計劃水上活動或海上作業的人士須加倍小心，離岸海面風浪較大。
天文台上午7晈50分更新的周日預測指，大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，初時部分地區雨勢較大及有雷暴，下午部分時間天色明朗，最高氣溫約30度。吹清勁偏東風，初時離岸吹強風，高地間中達烈風程度，海有大浪及湧浪。
上午8時，南海中部熱帶低氣壓集結在北緯17.1度、東經107.9度附近，預料移向越南沿岸。天文台指，東北季候風與該系統共同影響下，廣東沿岸及南海北部今日風勢頗大，間中有驟雨。展望周一短暫時間有陽光，早晚有幾陣驟雨及局部地區有雷暴。
